turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I’ve been feeling more confused than usual, and I can’t seem to get my thoughts into words. My temperature is about 102°F, and it hurts when you press on the right upper part of my belly.
Thank you for that information. To help narrow this down quickly, have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes, or any darkening of your urine or lightening of your stools?
Patient: I’ve noticed my skin and eyes look more yellow than usual, and my urine has been darker; I also think my stools look lighter than normal.
Have you experienced any shaking chills, or felt dizzy or lightheaded that might suggest your blood pressure is low?
“Doctor, yes—I’ve had shaking chills and I’ve been feeling quite weak and a bit lightheaded at times, like I might pass out.”
[DDX] Acute ascending cholangitis, Choledocholithiasis with biliary obstruction, Acute cholecystitis, Hepatic abscess, Severe acute hepatitis
